```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

##Load CSV
```{r}


penguins <- read.csv("penguins.csv")

```

### Basic descriptive analyses
```{r}

summary(penguins)

mean(penguins$bill_depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)

```


## Visualizations
```{r}

hist(penguins$body_mass_g)

hist(penguins$bill_length_mm)

```


```{r}
## p-chitima-branch
```

## Descriptive Statistics
```{r}
summary(penguins[, c("bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm","flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g")])
```
## Species and Sex
```{r}
table(penguins$species, penguins$sex, useNA = "ifany")
```


## Run a linear regression: Does flipper length predict body mass?
```{r}
model1 <- lm(body_mass_g ~ flipper_length_mm, data = penguins)
summary(model1)
```
